source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Select "Hardware status" > Click tab "Inventory and LEDs" then check the Chassis information and detail information

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Data should be readable and correct.

deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL pretty-printed JSON from /redfish/v1/Chassis/FRU_SYS/Sensors (Miramar sensor data) so user can read/diff against SPEC for "Miramar_Sensor". No RISK (read-only).

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES assumes a nested Sensors path, selects only Temperatures, weakens TLS and uses a jq expression whose coercion/precedence can corrupt name/value output.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED requires a complete vendor-mapped, unit-aware, freshness-aware sensor matrix and excludes stimulus or threshold changes.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 963/2291 accepts direct execution with only a generic command gate.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: FRU_SYS covers persistent inventory, while SMBus covers bus-device inventory; neither proves Miramar sensor telemetry correctness.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-33 preserves WebUI evidence; ED-34 permits approved equivalent telemetry sources; ED-35 rejects temperature-only coverage reduction; ED-36 treats sensor map/thresholds as readiness.

original_test_intent: Verify Miramar sensor information displayed under BMC Hardware status is readable and correct for the intended platform.
original_method: Enumerate every approved Miramar sensor, capture protected read-only telemetry and matching WebUI detail, normalize identity, units, reading, availability, health, thresholds and freshness, then compare each entry to the vendor/Project sensor map without stimulation.
manual_activity: The owner supplies the complete Miramar sensor map and expected unit/threshold/health semantics; the agent may collect and normalize telemetry, while the operator correlates WebUI and the engineer decides acceptance.
safety_requirements: Do not change thresholds, inject faults, alter power or reset the platform.
Enumerate the actual complete collection; do not assume FRU_SYS/Sensors or Temperatures-only coverage.
Use trusted transport and protected credentials.
Distinguish zero from absent, disabled, unavailable and stale readings.
Stop on duplicate identity, unknown units or stale/unparseable data without automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Resolve the authoritative Miramar sensor collection and all pages.
Collect complete redacted telemetry with timestamps.
Normalize per-sensor ID, name, type, reading, unit, health, availability and thresholds.
Correlate each record to WebUI and Project reference.
Report evidence only without stimulus or configuration changes.
engineer_actions: Approve sensor membership, thresholds and operating context.
Review exceptions and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Insufficient: an assumed path and temperature-only jq output omit non-temperature sensors, thresholds, health, availability and freshness; TLS is not verified.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Discover and page the actual sensor collection, preserve structured numeric values and timestamps, and compare a complete unit-aware matrix to WebUI/reference.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Miramar_Sensor, WebUI inspection, Criterion and original time values remain preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Perform protected complete sensor enumeration with unit, threshold, health and freshness checks under a no-stimulus boundary.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC, Redfish/OEM schema and parser versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor Miramar sensor/threshold map and Project operating specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds complete structured telemetry, reference semantics and no-stimulus safety while retaining WebUI verification.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Temperature names/readings alone are partial and cannot prove non-temperature membership, threshold configuration, health or freshness.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Sensor map, units, thresholds, state and freshness rules.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Readable cached values may be stale; duplicate labels or implicit units can yield convincing but wrong comparisons.

project_override_considerations: Alternate telemetry tools require approved sensor identity, unit/threshold/state equivalence, freshness evidence and explicit disclosure of uncovered WebUI/Redfish coverage.
expected_evidence: Complete member/page inventory and sensor topology
Raw redacted structured telemetry with timestamps

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master's broad readability/correctness goal is consistent; the DeepSeek temperature-only command is incomplete implementation guidance, not a competing source purpose.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The Miramar telemetry purpose is clear; exact population and expected semantics are Project execution-readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Corrects path assumption, jq type risk and temperature-only coverage.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Independently agrees with hybrid classification, complete telemetry and no-stimulus controls.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Adds collection completeness, freshness and semantic gates absent from generic direct-run review.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Keeps telemetry separate from static system and SMBus inventory.

review_improvement: Turns a fragile temperature list into a complete, auditable sensor matrix and prevents readable or stale data from being mistaken for correct platform telemetry.
independent_technical_reasoning: Sensor correctness requires identity, unit, state and time context. A single numeric reading can be syntactically readable yet stale, unavailable, wrongly scaled or mapped to a duplicate label; complete structured collection and authoritative thresholds are therefore essential, while fault stimulation is outside this view-only case.
